name: Call Board dailies pay Bazaar Tokens: twice their Callboard Cache points
contract: Each of the 44 Call Board dailies pays Bazaar Tokens (975001) beside its Runes of Ascension (375250): twice the quest's Callboard Cache points. A level-60 Human turning in a 25-point PvE daily (Scarlet Sweep: Magic and Might, 18034) receives 50 tokens and its 2000 runes, a 20-point PvE daily (Winterfall Purge, 17926) 40 tokens and 2000 runes, the 20-point PvP daily Duel! (80651) 40 tokens and 1000 runes, a 15-point Profession daily (Short on Supplies: Minor Mana Potion, 1005301) 30 tokens and 2000 runes, and the 15-point Dungeon Diving (81244) 30 tokens and 1500 runes. Every quest turn-in also pays the Ethereal Bazaar's random 0-6 tokens (EtherealBazaar.Tokens.Quest.Min/Max at default settings), so each turn-in adds 0-6 above the fixed amount. Paying fixed tokens is a CoA choice: no live quest paid them.
